name: European Union

flag.description: A blue field with a circle of twelve gold five-pointed stars in the centre.
flag.symbolism: The circle stands for unity, solidarity and harmony among the peoples of Europe; twelve is a symbol of completeness, not a count of members.

hook: Twelve gold stars in a ring on blue, and always twelve however many countries join; Cape Verde's ring has ten stars and sits on stripes.
trivia: The Council of Europe adopted the flag in 1955, three decades before the European Communities took it up in 1985.
The number of stars has never followed the number of members: there were twelve when the EU had twelve members and there are still twelve with 27.
